title: John Alexander's book finds no Majestic group
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of John Alexander's book finds no Majestic group, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: his book about UFOs, he claims that he never found any group like Majestic

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, says that John Alexander wrote a book about UFOs, or unidentified flying objects. According to Jorjani, Alexander claims in it that he never found any group like Majestic, a rumored secret committee said to control UFO knowledge, which would suggest such a group either does not exist or is hidden even from people like him.
